timingMethod: Actual automated browser operations at the public addresses. Captions use observed wall-clock event times aligned to recorded clip durations. Separate owner and recipient browser clips are joined in operation order; no UI is simulated.

chapters.en: Open GitHub Pages in a separate fresh browser: real browser calculation and device saving.
chapters.zh: 在另一全新浏览器打开GitHub Pages，使用真实浏览器计算与设备文件保存。

chapters.en: Name the mission and download its complete evidence file.
chapters.zh: 为任务命名并下载完整证据文件。

chapters.en: Reload GitHub Pages and reopen the saved file through My missions.
chapters.zh: 刷新GitHub Pages，通过我的任务重新打开设备文件。

chapters.en: Export the reopened evidence and verify identical JSON and consistent HTML.
chapters.zh: 导出重新打开的证据，核对JSON完全一致且HTML内容一致。
